entry.summary:

entry.summary: An MCP connection can stay healthy while its tool catalog becomes stale. Imagine a server that initially exposes a setup tool. Calling it makes another tool available, and the server sends a tool-list change notification. If the agent keeps using the catalog it fetched at connection time, its next model request still describes the old tools. AIClaw 3.7.23 closes that gap in the desktop Go kernel. entry.title: Costco, FedEx and H&R Block jobs API: the Jibe careers search, at five seconds a page
entry.summary:
Costco (careers.costco.com), FedEx (fedex.jibeapply.com), H&R Block, PetSmart, Ulta Beauty and Universal Health Services run their careers sites on Jibe (iCIMS Talent Cloud). The site answers one GET with JSON, and its robots.txt is Allow: / with crawl-delay: 5. curl -s "https://careers.costco.com/api/jobs?page=1&limit=100" \ | jq '.totalCount, (.jobs | length), .jobs[0].data.title'
Each job sits under jobs[].data and is richer than most careers APIs: title, req_id, street_address, city, state, postal_code, latitude and longitude, an ISO posted_date, the full description, categories and an apply_url. Four things to know, each measured on 2026-10-26 at one request every six seconds: limit=200 does not return 100. It answers HTTP 422 and no jobs. page=0 is a 422 too. The first page is page=1. Without a sort, Costco's first job had been posted at the end of July. Ask for sortBy=posted_date&descending=true and the first rows are the latest postings: curl -s "https://careers.costco.com/api/jobs?page=1&limit=5&sortBy=posted_date&descending=true" \ | jq -r '.jobs[].data | "\(.posted_date[:10]) \(.title)"'
FedEx's site held 136,186 open jobs that day: 1,362 pages, which at the five seconds its robots.txt asks for is close to two hours. Costco held 20,663, H&R Block 18,613. Unless you need everything, let the site filter: curl -s -G "https://careers.costco.com/api/jobs" --data-urlencode "page=1" \ --data-urlencode "limit=100" --data-urlencode "keywords=pharmacist" | jq '.totalCount'
keywords=pharmacist found 3,326 of Costco's jobs and location=Seattle found 538, each in one request. Company Career Page Jobs Scraper on Apify reads Costco, FedEx, H&R Block and the other Jibe employers by name, keeps to the five-second delay, and sends title and place filters to the site's own search. It covers 23 other career systems with the same row shape; their public endpoints, each with a tested curl, are in job-board-apis.
